Independent rational computation n=3 through n=15, strict ρ shells and reciprocal radii
correctness.rationale: PASS: The source-defined directed clock quasi-metric ρ_d=d(n²−n+1)/n−d(d+1)/2 has ρ1=(n−1)²/n and discrete increment ρ_{d+1}−ρ_d=n−d−2+1/n≥1/n for 1≤d≤n−2. Jevtić–Jelić–Živaljević prove strict quasi-metric irredundancy/cyclohedral polar, giving all n(n−1) distinct ordered-pair inequalities as genuine facets of L_n and all normalized roots as polar vertices. Norm(e_i−e_j)=sqrt2 in zero-sum H0, so exactly n facets at distance ρ_d/sqrt2 for each d, and n polar vertices at norm sqrt2/ρ_d. For any inscribed center c∈H0, add the n clockwise-nearest constraints c_i−c_{i+1}≤ρ1−r sqrt2: telescoping yields r≤ρ1/sqrt2; equality forces c=0. For polar outer roots v_i=(e_i−e_{i+1})/ρ1, Σv_i=0 and averaging ||v_i−y||² yields R²+||y||², so minimum enclosing radius sqrt2/ρ1 has unique center y=0. Contact orbit and reciprocal identity follow. Our independent exact rational checker verified monotonic shells for n=3,…,15, only corroborating the symbolic proof.
